head: b1b16d4
note: Three calibration names only; no text, no excerpts. The 51 ordinary owner files are aggregate in the compare artifact; the known-bad file is a label, not a name. Every file carries defect_type + defect_types + measured evidence.

files.name: نظام الشركات 1439 سعد الخنفري.pdf
files.defect: numerals-mixed (owner-adjudicated; the text is lexically valid, the defect is the numeral forms)

defect_evidence.note: The file-level signal is numerals-mixed; the lam-alef transposition is measured in the same three readers and is recorded, not raised by a shipped signal.

files.name: ٣ - درس - البايثون.pdf
files.defect: lam-alef transposition (PDFium/MuPDF/poppler 21 each; PDFKit 0; PDFMiner reads reversed). The lexical ratio is a symptom, not a lexical-only defect; file-level low because 3 of 5 judged readers are at/above 0.67. The floor is not lowered.

defect_evidence.note: ToUnicode/lam-alef order: 21 in the three readers that trust the map; PDFKit 0 (font cmap); PDFMiner reads reversed so the detector is blind. The lexical floor is NOT lowered: the file is low at file level because 3 of 5 judged readers are at/above 0.67, while the defect is named at reader level. Under the shipped lam-alef file signal (2026-11-25) the file's level is medium: the density rule, not a lowered lexical floor, is what raises it.

shipped_rule.basis: derived, not re-measured: 3 of 5 readers at 43.03-43.66 per 1000 Arabic runs (21 transpositions in 473-488 runs) against the shipped 6.2, and 3 of 5 is the majority (measurements/lam-alef-separation.json). The level deposited at b1b16d4 — before the file signal existed — was low; the shipped rule returns medium for these numbers, and that rule is asserted (not re-measured here: the three calibration files are the owner's and are not in this tree): the recorded field is asserted by scripts/test_calibration.py, the rule that returns the level by arabic_pdf_check/tests/test_lam_alef_signal.py, and its arithmetic by scripts/test_lam_alef_separation.py.

files.name: 7  - درس - مهارات التواصل.pdf
files.defect: lexical-validity high (garbled words; all five readers below the current and candidate thresholds)

defect_evidence.note: All five judged readers are below the 0.67 floor; the lam-alef transposition is a second measured defect, recorded as defect_types[1].

numerals-mixed.definition: a number that mixes Arabic-Indic and Latin digits; measured by conformance.checks.structure.mixed_numbers

lam-alef-transposition.definition: the lam-alef ligature is mapped in visual order (e.g. «األهداف» for «الأهداف»); arafix detector through conformance/checks/visual_order.py:32, surfaced as lexical.validity(...).lam_alef
lam-alef-transposition.level: reader-level unless a shipped majority signal exists

lexical-validity.definition: a majority of judged readers return Arabic runs that are not Arabic words; measured against the shipped lexicon at the measured floor
